## Procedure

1. Begin in the Athletic Stance (-14) facing away from the starting line
2. When ready, backpedal to the first line (5 yards) and touch it with either foot
3. Turn and backpedal back to the starting line and touch it with both hands
4. Turn and backpedal to the second line (10 yards) and touch it with either foot
5. Turn and backpedal back to the starting line and touch it with both hands
6. Turn and backpedal to the first line again (5 yards), touch it with either foot, then turn and backpedal past the starting line
7. Perform this drill using the following distances: 10 yards - 5 yards - 10 yards, 5 yards - 5 yards - 5 yards, 5 yards - 10 yards - 15 yards, and 15 yards - 10 yards - 5 yards
